final_message:
Done — all 3 tests pass plus README/edge checks.

- `build_order` (buildplan/order.py:32): Kahn's algorithm with a min-heap so alphabetically-first targets are emitted whenever several are ready; deps are normalized into sets (duplicates count once, dep-only names become targets, input untouched).
- Cycle reporting (buildplan/order.py:57): when targets remain unplaced, an iterative DFS walks names alphabetically (deps alphabetically) and reports the first name already on the current path as `cycle = path[i:] + [name]`, e.g. `["lexer", "tokens", "parser", "lexer"]`.
- `rebuild_set` (buildplan/order.py:76): reverse-dependency closure from `changed` (unknown names ignored), returned filtered from the full `build_order`, so it raises `CycleError` the same way.

+def _dep_map(deps: Mapping[str, Iterable[str]]) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
+    targets: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+    for name, needs in deps.items():
+        targets[name] = set(needs)
+    mentioned: set[str] = set()
+    for needs in targets.values():
+        mentioned.update(needs)
+    for name in mentioned:
+        targets.setdefault(name, set())
+    return targets
+
+
+def _dependents(targets: Mapping[str, set[str]]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    users: dict[str, list[str]] = {name: [] for name in targets}
+    for name, needs in targets.items():
+        for need in needs:
+            users[need].append(name)
+    return users
